BiblicalUsage: The Aramaic word for seed appears once, in Daniel's reading of Nebuchadnezzar's dream. The iron and clay of the last kingdom will mingle ‘with the seed of men’ — kingdoms joined by marriage, trying to hold together what will not hold. The seed here is human stock, the offspring of men, and the mixture fails.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Daniel's picture still warns me: human alliances cannot glue together what only God can unite.
